name: git
description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow, a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup, and idempotent per-spec worktree entry. Changelog (last 3): 1.6.0 — /git:merge refuses a proto/* source outright (it is never merged, freeze it via /spec:prototype instead) and reports a harden/* source outside the review driver's merge-back as out of loop, since harden/<stem> is meant to land only through /spec:run. 1.5.0 — /git:enter-worktree re-attaches a parked spec branch (branch kept, worktree directory gone) through merge-back.sh create --attach, so the .worktreeinclude copy and setup still run; a listed worktree entry whose directory is missing falls through to that path instead of failing entry. 1.4.0 — `/git:enter-worktree` is now the manual repair surface for a spec's worktree rather than a documented pre-step, because the spec loop opens the worktree itself before any stage runs; its Step 2 gains an already-inside short-circuit, so re-entering the tree the session is already in reports re-entered and stops without re-running host setup or rewriting the recorded base branch.
